metadata.label: scammer_address_poisoning
metadata.description: Address poisoning factory — first-funds lookalike wallets that send dust to trick users into sending funds back to the wrong address

addresses.comment: Address poisoning deployer — creates wallets mimicking first/last chars of real addresses, sends dust to trick users
Address poisoning deployer — creates wallets mimicking first/last chars of real addresses, sends dust to trick users
Moved from generic scammer.json. Mid-layer poisoning factory: child of EQDigSX, first-funds hundreds of thousands of lookalike one-time wallets.

addresses.source: https://tonviewer.com/EQDng8H0_g9e-Lslqy90AbAr4N57MfN8BXo61FoHMWgjlWlD First-funded by NowPayments. First-funded ~616k wallets (May-Aug 2026). Children send 0.0001 TON dust to unique destinations.
addresses.comment: Largest unlabeled 2026 poisoning factory. Seed so invited lookalike wallets can be expanded dynamically.

addresses.source: https://tonviewer.com/EQCh1FHIznBgX670SvgSDVXArs0kDanhoNK5Pqza1_vZjVSG First-funded by Binance. First-funded ~201k wallets (Mar-Jun 2026). Same lookalike-dust schema.
addresses.comment: Poisoning factory. Also first-funds one-time spam wallets such as EQAgWcTL and EQBXSI4S.

addresses.source: https://tonviewer.com/EQDmpFD0vP4ilFaKEGhu7WgCftfvGouLw3hj2qNiPg77FkHK First-funded ~77k wallets and is the first funder of EQDXmIXK.
addresses.comment: Poisoning factory and parent of the EQDXmIXK factory. Label the parent so both hops expand.
